# SD18 deterministic Human Paladin level 11 widening fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD13-E5 deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Paladin
# level-1..level-10 hybrid chassis baseline (tests/sd13_paladin_level10_progression.rs)
# to level 11 as chosen input only. It names selections; it does not contain
# derived, computed, or parity values. It preserves the accepted Human
# race-choice seam (ability-bonus and bonus-feat), the deterministic
# Longsword / Chain Shirt / no-shield / Power Attack posture, and the
# level-3..level-10 fixture's choice=choice:paladin_mercy selection
# (mercy:shaken) unchanged -- 11th is NOT a repeat-Mercy-grant level (the
# 3rd/6th/9th cadence), so this fixture adds no new mercy selection.
#
# The PF1 CRB Paladin class table's level-11 "Special" column reads "Aura of
# justice" only (verified independently against both d20pfsrd and
# legacy.aonprd.com) -- a paladin can expend two uses of her smite evil
# ability to share the smite-evil ability with allies within 10 feet, using
# her own bonuses. Grounded here as a new bounded grant-only identity record
# (class_chassis.paladin.aura_of_justice, value 0, non-fabricated), mirroring
# exactly how Diamond Body's own poison-immunity grant was grounded at Monk
# 11th level: no ally-aura/positional engine and no smite-evil-resource-
# sharing execution engine exists anywhere in this codebase to apply the
# shared smite to.
#
# It deliberately avoids every later hybrid burden surface: no spell
# selections, no spells known/prepared posture, no domains, no mercy EFFECT
# resolution, no channel positive energy healing/damage-resolution execution,
# no Divine Bond (weapon bond / mount bond) selection or execution, no
# Aura of Justice's own smite-sharing resolution, and no level-12+
# progression.
case_id=pf1-crb-human-paladin-level11
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:paladin:11
ability=strength:16
ability=dexterity:12
ability=constitution:14
ability=intelligence:10
ability=wisdom:10
ability=charisma:14
feat=feat:power_attack
skill=skill:diplomacy:1
equipment=item:chain_shirt:equipped_worn_active
equipment=item:longsword:equipped_primary_active
equipment=item:shield:absent
choice=choice:level_1_character_feat:feat:power_attack
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
choice=choice:human_ability_bonus:ability:charisma
choice=choice:paladin_mercy:mercy:shaken
provenance=programs/codex/requirements/SD-13-core-class-race-roster-and-level-10-progression-matrix/artifacts/core-roster-and-support-state-matrix.md
